article.title: Driving vehicles in contravention of section 3 or section 4.
article.content:
181Driving vehicles in contravention of section 3 or section 4.

Section 181  ·  Chapter XIII  ·  page 101 of the Act
Whoever, drives a motor vehicle in contravention of section 3 or section 4 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine 5[of five thousand rupees], or with both.
5 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 63, for “which may extend to five hundred rupees” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).
